newsitem.title: USA: AMCOL unit says to build Miss. plant.
newsitem.headline: AMCOL unit says to build Miss. plant.

text.p: Nanocor Inc, a unit of AMCOL International Corp, said Monday it will proceed with construction of its first plant in Aberdeen, Miss., in early 1997, at an estimated cost of $3 million.

The plant will have annual production capacity of 10,000 metric tonnes, with infrastructure in place for expansion to 20,000 metric tonnes, of high-purity clay suitable for various commercial applications and nanocomposite plastics.
AMCOL is a specialty chemical and mineral company.
